title: Stack Sauce running short in the Southeast

messages.text: Atlanta Buckhead and two other Atlanta stores ran out of Stack Sauce for part of Saturday. Crew pulled the Double Stack from the board for about five hours.
Same at Charlotte Uptown on Sunday lunch. We are selling far more Double Stacks than the plan mix said.
Confirmed. The Southeast was allocated on the 22% plan mix and is running well above it. Atlanta DC is the lowest of the four centres and the next delivery is not until May 19.
Proposal: move sauce cases from Columbus DC to Atlanta DC this week, two days in transit. Columbus keeps enough cover for the Midwest. Needs a Supply Chain sign-off before it ships.
